meta.expect: She does not accept mechanically, does not invent Owen's availability, does not restart at her opening. She negotiates the new condition (e.g. she is present, it is not an interrogation, terms in writing).

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, Hale, and on what basis?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else, I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
The document history shows 612 words at 11:52 PM and 794 at 11:58 PM on October 28, in two single edits, with no earlier drafts. You can check it on my screen.
Turn the screen, Hale. I'm writing down 612 words at 11:52 PM and 794 at 11:58 PM, October 28. A timestamp tells me when something was saved, not who wrote it, so what else do you have?
The essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here is the scene.
Show me the scene. I'm writing down Act 3, Scene 2, and "The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile." Whatever happens next, Hale, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

I accept the private rewrite, no disciplinary finding, and written confirmation. There is one condition: Owen attends a ten-minute meeting tomorrow and explains the writing process himself. You may attend, but you cannot answer for him. Does Thursday at 8:15 work?

You said tomorrow and you said Thursday, Hale, and tomorrow is Wednesday, so which is it? I'll be in that room, and the written confirmation says nothing goes on his file, in those words, under your own procedure 4.4. The rewrite is supervised, private, not in front of his class, and I'm agreeing to it to put this behind him.
